title: RHINELAB
text:
RHINELAB-RINALAB - Theoretical Modelling and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory


Focusing on theoretical analysis, foundational researches, and dissections with adversarial verifications of theoretical bodies.

Welcome to the main website of RHINELAB-RINALAB, a theoretical and semi-experimental research laboratory in-formation.
At the moment, we are in the process of working out foundation, build-up only at present, with the goal to investigate the theoretical aspects, the assumption stacks, the scaffolding and dependencies, simplification gaps thereof between fields and subject of interest. Specifically, we are interested in

Artificial intelligence and its theory of the mind, interdisciplinary as it is, but to look at the foundational questions and ask of the relevant clarification;
Theoretical computer science and the expansion of computers in more general terms - may or may not Turing, but the middle-ground in-between actual complex devices;
Theory of modelling, where model takes precedence of any theoretical bodies of studies, be physics or biologies, targeting the theoretical-practical mismatch, abstraction corruptions, layering drifts, the ontological and epistemic techniques and framework of mathematical model;

Those, and physics, both practical consideration and theoretical foundational topics, such as mathematical physics, material sciences and so on. Additionally, we also host practical works, for example, improving existing framework - NLP-LLM structures on observed dilemma (catastrophic forgetting or language drift, for example), material science designs for cancerous detection/solvent application, and hardware-hardwired neural formalism structures, which is a project in itself of the lab.







Currently, we are accepting team-members and collaborators, please see the about page for more information for that matter. Current list of laboratory (fancy name, but rather just direction of research) can be found in the research page, project page, and current list of members and collaborators associated as in people page. Please note that the website are in progress and many of the preparation are not finished, so it would take a while until everything are in place for developments.






Note



Currently, the website is static, and thus it requires compilation. Because it uses Quarto as the base, which is a deliberate positioning choice for prototyping, I guess we will have to be ado with other subjects in the meantime. For now, modification to the website is locked to Directors and Leader.

Encoding-Modelling Theory (AET): A Pre-formal Theory of Modelling


Zenodo Preprint


2026


A precursor formulation of Ambiance-Encoding Theory (AET), proposing a framework that separates empirically accessible physical systems (ambiance space) from their formal mathematical representations (encoding space). The work outlines validation requirements for scientific models, including explicit ambiance specification, justified encoding schemes, and classification of structures as either ambiance-invariant or encoding artifacts.

title: RHINELAB-RINALAB Group
text:
The RHINELAB-RINALAB theoretical research laboratory, or on presumption being theoretical physics, theoretical artificial intelligence and automata theories, is an open-source laboratory/research group focusing on the following list of topics:

Theoretical computer science: the study of computer or generally, dynamic processing constructs, of whom are to be said of automatic(on), and their structural configurations.
Mathematical studies of abstract objects.

Theory of modelling.
Theoretical artificial intelligence and artificial intelligence deployment system (LLM, which falls into that category).
Physical system modelling and theoretical evaluations.

At the current stage of development, we are mostly concerned with the theoretical aspect, including touching on simulation and stress-testing systems. Because of the lacking in manpower, which is expected during the formation phase, currently active direction, labelled as laboratory directive, contains the following sects as listed below: RHINE-MTAIL, RHINE-MAPR, RHINE-TAAI, and RHINE-EPEFORM.


RHINELAB is founded on the vision and preparation, philosophy and thereof from Bui Gia Khanh (or can be called 藤宮天音/Fujimiya Amane), an undergraduate student, in major of Physics and focused on degree to theoretical physics and mathematical analysis. However, aside from such, his focus is coherently broad, with interests being in neuroscience or foundational/computational neuroscience, theoretical Artificial Intelligence (TAI) analysis, statistical learning theory and adjacent conjunction that makes up learning theory, computational biology and/or foundational biology in specificity, foundational mathematics and its related topics, and a broader scheme of philosophy, applied/natural science and more. His specialties are also modelling theory, and the problem of ‘mathematical operationalization’, M-oper, about descriptions and specifications turn into actualizable 1 and operationable objects or constructs in practice, and the gap between them. Most of what the laboratory does circles around the system of knowledge from what he wrote of the manifesto and directives on.






First actual lab meeting that has any picture to show for, so yes.


Alright, now comes the location.

library(leaflet)
leaflet(height = 500) %>%

This is where the current ‘office’ of RHINELAB are situated within, and I would say we are doing quite well with how the operations are going. To be in truth, I feel like we are progressing for material accumulation pretty much alright.






Important



Recently, basing on a new organization template, the laboratory decided to change from Group to Division for its uppermost bracketing. This means that everyone will be in departments as nominal for now, resultant consequences later, even then though, we will have hierarchy down below it.
His vision and purpose embedded to RHINELAB (or more so of its second name as RINALAB), is to be an open-source, open-discourse, open-knowledge with caveat, research and foundational knowledge laboratory, laying on the principle of principle logistics and question-generative research - where the main goal of research is to ask more questions, correctly so. Explicitly stated, the organization, owned by him as it is, focus on its intellectual contents and resources to be \((i)\) contextually open-source, accessible for all aside from private and sensitive operational and managerial information, \((ii)\) every question, every intellectual discourse or argument debate are to be, in conjunction with rules of expression, accepted of discussions and existence; this is extended to open-knowledge, that is, ideally that the lab would try to do and experiment on this mode is to expose all intellectual results to the public space governed by the lab system, auditing research movements within rules and attribution of the people created those resources, and so on. Furthermore, \((iii)\), he aims for the creation and crystallization of foundational investigation and research, as the core research arrow of the laboratory to investigate deep, recreating and capture foundations and further spin-out knowledge rather than just consumption or relying on source availability 2 - it also means one of the main goal of the lab is to build on itself, a basis of knowledge and library of Alexandria for RHINELAB in its entirety. Finally, \((iv)\), he emphasizes the need for researching and deploying logistical support and smoothing for researcher, the researching machines and constructs. He believes that without principle logistics, something like Occam’s razor, then research would be tiresome, hard, difficult with high barrier of entries, and tedious beyond measure of what is required.

title: Mathematical and Physical Research Group
text:
Working and principles
For now, let us introduce briefly of the details concerning the members of RHINELAB Physics Group Members, and what we are to expect people working inside this fundamental angle of research. Within this group we investigate and research problems in the field of Physics, in general. The hierarchy of the group will be as follows, starting as a branching office from RHINELAB in full. \[
\text{RHINELAB Physics Group}\rightarrow\left\{\begin{matrix}
\text{Mathematics and Theoretical Physics Subgroup}\\
\text{Nuclear Physics Subgroup} \\
\text{Mathematics and Foundation Building Subgroup}
\end{matrix}\right.
\] And, subsequently, for RHINELAB Physics Group, such includes some of the major research anecdotes that are of focus for foundation of physical knowledge as we realize it so: \[
\text{RHINELAB Physics Group}\rightarrow
\left\{ \begin{matrix}
\text{Mathematical Physics}\\
\text{Statistics and Probability Theory} \\
\text{Quantum Physics} \\
\text{Theoretical Nuclear Physics}
\end{matrix} \right.
\]
The focus, and the contents in specificity of focus can be and will be different later on, however within the scope of foundational build-up of present, the plan is to rely on those fields to establish a sound foundation before attempting any serious works.
